title: Social Media Agency in Dallas
metaTitle: Social Media Agency in Dallas, TX | TDM
metaDescription: Social media management for Dallas businesses: strategy, content calendars, daily posting, community replies and paid social. Quote after a free consultation.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) runs social media for Dallas businesses: strategy, content, daily posting, replies to comments and messages, and paid social. We work remotely as an outside team that behaves like your own department. Dallas is a city that dresses up, eats out and follows its neighbourhoods closely online, and it is also a corporate centre where LinkedIn carries real commercial weight. The plan we write depends on which of those worlds your customers live in.

sections.heading: Two audiences, two kinds of feed
paragraphs: Consumer brands in Dallas compete on appearance. Diners choose between restaurants in Bishop Arts, Lower Greenville, Knox-Henderson and Trinity Groves by scrolling through dishes and interiors. Shoppers follow boutiques in Highland Park Village and the Design District showrooms. Salons, med spas and fitness studios are judged on their last few posts. For these businesses Instagram and TikTok act as a shop window, and a neglected profile reads as a neglected business.

The corporate side is quieter but no less active. Commercial real estate brokers, recruiters, consultants and software vendors in Dallas, Plano and Irving use LinkedIn to stay in front of people who buy once or twice a year. What works there is useful commentary from named people at the firm, project news and proof of work, posted steadily.

sections.heading: What we take off your hands
paragraphs: We begin by reviewing your current channels and competitors, then agree a platform-by-platform strategy and a monthly calendar. Nothing is published until you have approved it.
bullets: Content creation: graphics, captions, Reels, Stories and short-form video shaped for each platform.
Daily posting and profile upkeep on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn.
Community management, with comments, direct messages and reviews answered promptly in your brand voice.
Paid social on Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn that promotes the posts already performing well.
Monthly reports on reach, engagement, follower growth, traffic and paid results.

sections.heading: Where the photos and footage come from
paragraphs: Social accounts run on fresh pictures and clips, so the plan says where each month's material will come from. Planned content, such as a menu launch, a showroom tour or a set of product photographs, is filmed and photographed by our team in the United States, on location at your premises or wherever suits the brief. Those files then go to our operations office in Lahore, where the design, editing and retouching are done. We have no office in Dallas, so shoot days are scheduled in advance and built to yield weeks of posts.

Between shoot days, everyday moments still matter. Audiences respond to footage that looks real, and a manager with a phone catches things no scheduled session can. If your staff like to film, we edit what they send, but it is an addition and never a condition.

sections.heading: A calendar built on local moments
paragraphs: Dallas gives a content calendar plenty to work with. The State Fair of Texas and the Texas-OU weekend fill the city each autumn. Cowboys Sundays, Mavericks and Stars nights at the American Airlines Center shape when people go out. Patio weather in spring and autumn is short and celebrated, and the summer heat pushes activity indoors and into the evening. We plan posts and promotions around the dates that matter to your trade.

presence: TDM manages social media for Dallas businesses without an office in Dallas. Photos and video for the calendar are captured by our team in the United States, design and editing are done at our operations office in Lahore, and planning, posting and reporting are handled online.

faqs.q: Which social platforms matter most for a Dallas business?
faqs.a: It depends on the customer. Restaurants, retail and beauty lean on Instagram and TikTok. Firms selling to other companies get more from LinkedIn. Facebook remains useful for neighbourhood groups and for home services in the suburbs. We recommend a short list and do those well.

faqs.q: Can an agency with no Dallas office manage social media for a restaurant here?
faqs.a: Yes. Our US-based team films and photographs the dishes, the room and the people on planned shoot days, and our editors in Lahore cut and caption the results. We schedule the posts and handle replies. Clips your own staff capture between shoots are welcome too.

faqs.q: Do you run LinkedIn for Dallas B2B firms?
faqs.a: We do. That covers the company page, content written with your subject experts, and paid campaigns aimed at job titles and industries when there is a budget for them.

faqs.q: How is social media management priced?
faqs.a: By scope: the number of platforms, the volume of content each month and whether community management and paid social are included. A quote follows a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long before a new social plan is up and running?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief and on how much brand material already exists. The start date and the first calendar are agreed in the plan.
